title: Titanium Thermowell
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this tank hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by temperature sensor protective thermowell and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells
commonFailures: Contact burn at rack hook from insufficient clamp - resolved by BeCu spring contact 5N minimum force

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Thermowell suitable for Temperature sensor protective thermowell?
faq.a: Titanium Thermowell uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address tank hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Thermowell?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Thermowell require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. tank hardware components receive Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Thermowell shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Thermowell / Sensor well tank hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
